title: WordPress 7.1.2 Stack Variables
description: Configuration variables and deployment parameters for WordPress 7.1.2 enterprise WAMP/LAMP stack.

WORDPRESS_VERSION.description: Target WordPress core version to deploy (e.g. '7.1.2' or 'latest').

WORDPRESS_SITE_TITLE.description: Initial website and blog title for the WordPress installation.

WORDPRESS_ADMIN_USER.description: Initial administrator username for WordPress authentication.

WORDPRESS_ADMIN_PASSWORD.description: Initial administrator password for WordPress authentication.

WORDPRESS_ADMIN_EMAIL.description: Initial administrator email address receiving system notifications.

WORDPRESS_SITE_URL.description: Canonical public site URL (WP_SITEURL), including protocol and optional port.

WORDPRESS_HOME_URL.description: Canonical public homepage URL (WP_HOME), including protocol and optional port.

WORDPRESS_SERVER_NAME.description: Virtual host domain name or hostname used in web server configuration.

WORDPRESS_LISTEN.description: TCP port on which the web server listens for incoming HTTP requests.

WORDPRESS_WWWROOT.description: Filesystem path to the WordPress document root directory.

WORDPRESS_PHP_VERSION.description: Target PHP runtime version required for WordPress execution.

WORDPRESS_PHP_FPM_LISTEN.description: UNIX domain socket path or TCP host:port where PHP-FPM FastCGI listens.

WORDPRESS_PHP_POST_MAX_SIZE.description: Maximum POST request body size directive (e.g. '128M').

WORDPRESS_PHP_MAX_EXECUTION_TIME.description: Maximum script execution timeout in seconds.

WORDPRESS_PHP_MAX_INPUT_VARS.description: Maximum number of input variables accepted via GET/POST/cookies.

WORDPRESS_PHP_OPCACHE_ENABLE.description: Whether to enable Zend OPcache bytecode accelerator.

WORDPRESS_REUSE_OPENEDX_DB.description: Whether to detect, reuse, and coexist with an existing Open edX MySQL/MariaDB database instance.

WORDPRESS_OPENEDX_CONFIG_PATH.description: Custom filesystem path override for Open edX configuration discovery.

WORDPRESS_DBAAS_URL.description: Connection URI for remote hosted DBaaS (e.g. 'mysql://user:pass@host:3306/db?ssl-ca=ca.pem').

WORDPRESS_DB_HOST.description: Relational database server host or TCP host:port.

WORDPRESS_DB_NAME.description: Database schema name dedicated to WordPress.

WORDPRESS_DB_USER.description: Database user account credential for WordPress connections.

WORDPRESS_DB_PASS.description: Database user password credential for WordPress connections.

WORDPRESS_DB_SSL_CA.description: Filesystem path to certificate authority (CA) bundle for TLS database connections.

WORDPRESS_DB_SSL_VERIFY.description: Whether to strictly verify the database server TLS certificate.

WORDPRESS_TABLE_PREFIX.description: Relational database table prefix for WordPress tables.

WORDPRESS_REVERSE_PROXY_MODE.description: Whether to trust reverse-proxy SSL headers (HTTP_X_FORWARDED_PROTO/HOST) to avoid redirect loops.

WORDPRESS_ENABLE_REDIS.description: Whether to install and activate Redis Object Cache drop-in for WordPress.

WORDPRESS_REDIS_HOST.description: Redis daemon host for object caching.

WORDPRESS_REDIS_PORT.description: Redis daemon TCP port for object caching.

WORDPRESS_ENABLE_PHPMYADMIN.description: Whether to deploy Adminer/phpMyAdmin database management web interface.

WORDPRESS_ENABLE_CRON_OFFLOAD.description: Whether to disable web traffic WP-Cron and offload to native host crontab or Task Scheduler.

WORDPRESS_UPDATE_HOSTS_FILE.description: Whether to automatically register the virtual hostname in the operating system hosts file.
